style: Studio Ghibli hand-drawn cel-animation foreground: fine brown linework, broad matte flat fills, one restrained shadow tone; natural painted meadow background

official_style_reference.purpose: Linework, flat cel-color treatment and foreground/background relationship only. Characters and scene composition are not copied.

characters.prompt:

effects.prompt:

Row 4: dusky violet with warm yellow animated absorption, four stages of a simple inward spiral of energy strokes, ending in a single warm little spark.
Flat hand-painted cel-animation finish, no watercolor stains. True alpha outside shapes, no white/black/checkerboard background or paper rectangles.
